title: Real Crypto Support Will Never DM You First
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Scammers pose as exchange or wallet support and ask for your seed phrase or a remote screen share. Sources: Coinbase and Kraken help centers. AI-generated voice. Has anyone ever messaged you pretending to be support? Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: SCAM WARNING
scenes.hook: SUPPORT WILL NEVER DM YOU FIRST
scenes.narration: Real crypto support will never message you first.

scenes.head: THE TRICK
scenes.hook: FAKE AGENTS COPY REAL SUPPORT PAGES
scenes.narration: Scammers pose as exchange or wallet support. They copy names and logos, then say your account has a problem.

scenes.head: THE ASK
scenes.hook: SEED PHRASE OR SCREEN SHARE? IT IS A SCAM
scenes.narration: They ask for your seed phrase, a code, or to share your screen. Exchanges say they never ask for these.

scenes.head: THE FIX
scenes.hook: CLOSE THE CHAT. OPEN THE OFFICIAL APP
scenes.narration: Stop replying. Open the official app yourself and use the help section there.

scenes.head: ONE CRYPTO BASIC A DAY
scenes.narration: Follow for one crypto basic a day. Educational only. Not financial advice.
